title: Providing and laying water supply and Sewer connection from CMWSSB to Chennai Lighthouse.
summary: E-tender (percentage rate) for laying water supply and sewer connections from the Chennai Metro Water (CMWSSB) network to Chennai Lighthouse, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Chennai Lighthouse, Chennai, Tamilnadu
sites.work: Water supply and sewer connection from CMWSSB

scope.item: Providing and laying water supply and sewer connection from CMWSSB to Chennai Lighthouse

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalized bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai; validity three months (table) / 90 days (clause 1.1) from technical bid opening; exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous body

Similar works in last seven years: three works each >= 40%, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; completed works only; value enhanced at 7% per annum; certificates from officers not below Executive Engineer
Similar works: repairs and civil maintenance of buildings or construction of any type of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC structures
Average annual turnover on civil construction/repair works at least 40% of estimated cost over last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2025, CA certified
PAN, GST registration, ITR for last three assessment years; key technical personnel

Tender acceptance letter (Annexure II), unconditional bid undertaking (Annexure III), non-blacklisting affidavit (Annexure IV), relatives declaration (Annexure V), bid security declaration (Annexure VI), Make in India self-certification (Annexure VII)
notes: Scanned Section I NIT only; no BOQ, pipe lengths or drawings. Download and bid submission 05.06.2025 15:00 to 19.06.2025 15:00; EMD up to 19.06.2025 15:00; opening 20.06.2025 15:00.
